popup_text.1: Level input: verified partial 2025 report, annualized
popup_text.2: Level input: recent official agency history
popup_text.6: Level input: official state benchmark plus modeled nonreporting mass
popup_text.7: Level input: 2025 filing failed review; recent reviewed history used
popup_text.8: Level input: statewide residual rather than a local report
popup_text.9: Level input: modeled footprint territory outside the submission
popup_text.0: 2025 total observed from complete official report
popup_text.1: 2025 total annualized from verified partial report
popup_text.2: 2025 total repaired from recent agency history
popup_text.4: 2025 total repaired from a verified official source
popup_text.6: 2025 total includes modeled benchmark mass for nonreporting territory
popup_text.7: 2025 filing failed level review; displayed level is not a complete observed total
popup_text.8: 2025 level is a statewide residual, not a complete local observation
popup_text.9: 2025 total includes modeled mass for footprint territory outside the submission

pct_above_basis.rule: share strictly above the break, denominated on units that have a value for that layer

popup_text.imputed: Most of this cell's estimated incidents are modeled — from the state benchmark for a non-reporting agency, or for territory a filing does not cover — rather than directly reported.

default_layer_violence_disclosure.label: Violent risk much higher than composite suggests
default_layer_violence_disclosure.popup_text: The tract-supported murder index is at least four times the national average while the Activity-adjusted score is below 100. That score is weighted by the national volume of all seven offenses, so severe violence can be hidden by low property-crime estimates.

data_vintage.detail: Current annual crime risk estimated from complete reporting years through 2025. The separate accounting tables retain calendar-2025 totals. Geometry is 2020 Census block groups. This snapshot was frozen on 18 Aug 2026 from build ff7f37ca5cf4.

general.default_override_note: Special-use classification is descriptive. A value is published when its denominator passes the applicable minimum.
general.insufficient_exposure_note: The applicable denominator is below its publication minimum. Expected counts and density remain available.
general.county_proxy_localization_note: Some state-police, patrol, constable, precinct, and county-named overlap agencies are localized to the coded county as a county-proxy geography; post, precinct, and service-area footprints are not exact county boundaries.

insufficient_exposure.disclaimer: The applicable denominator is below its publication minimum. Expected counts and density remain available.

aggravated_assault.disclaimer: Primary denominator: estimated person-present exposure. Resident denominator: resident population.

burglary.disclaimer: Primary denominator: estimated residential and commercial premises exposure. Resident denominator: resident population.

larceny.disclaimer: Primary denominator: estimated person-present and commercial-activity exposure. Resident denominator: resident population.

motor_vehicle_theft.disclaimer: Primary denominator: estimated regularly present vehicles. Resident denominator: resident population.

murder.disclaimer: Census-tract estimate. Primary denominator: estimated person-present exposure. Resident denominator: resident population.

rape.disclaimer: Census-tract estimate. Primary denominator: estimated person-present exposure. Resident denominator: resident population.

robbery.disclaimer: Primary denominator: estimated person-present exposure. Resident denominator: resident population.
